nl: How many suppliers are there?
sparql: PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?prov) AS ?numProveedores) WHERE { ?prov a foaf:Organization . }

nl: List the requirements that do not have a physical model (Satisfied_by).
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?req ?id ?desc WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id . OPTIONAL { ?req p510:Description ?desc } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?req p510:Satisfied_by ?link . ?link p510:Link ?modelo . ?link p510:ContentType "Physical Model" . } }

nl: Which physical models do not have any associated test (Verified_by)?
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?modelo ?id ?desc WHERE { ?modelo rdf:type p510:DesignModel ; p510:Id ?id ; p510:ContentType "Physical Model" . OPTIONAL { ?modelo p510:Description ?desc } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?modelo p510:Verified_by ?link . ?link p510:Link ?test . ?link p510:ContentType "Test Case" . } }

nl: Compute the percentage of requirements that have at least one physical model.
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT (100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ?reqConModelo) / COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?percentage) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req p510:Satisfied_by ?link . ?link p510:ContentType "Physical Model" ; p510:Link ?modelo . BIND(?req AS ?reqConModelo) } }

nl: Find requirements missing end-to-end traceability (Req → Model → Test).
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?req ?id WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?req p510:Satisfied_by ?l1 . ?l1 p510:ContentType "Physical Model" ; p510:Link ?modelo . ?modelo p510:Verified_by ?l2 . ?l2 p510:ContentType "Test Case" ; p510:Link ?test . } }

nl: List over-specified requirements (more than one physical model).
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?req ?id (COUNT(DISTINCT ?modelo) AS ?numModelos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id ; p510:Satisfied_by ?link . ?link p510:ContentType "Physical Model" ; p510:Link ?modelo . } GROUP BY ?req ?id HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?modelo) > 1) ORDER BY DESC(?numModelos)

nl: Give me the PLM summary from the manifest (organization, purpose, version...).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?org ?created ?purpose ?objective ?version WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_GeneralPLMInfo ?info . OPTIONAL { ?info p510:Organization ?org } OPTIONAL { ?info p510:Created_on ?created } OPTIONAL { ?info p510:Model_Purpose ?purpose } OPTIONAL { ?info p510:Model_Objective ?objective } OPTIONAL { ?info p510:Version_identifier ?version } }

nl: Show the development environment (tools, OS, language).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?tool ?toolVer ?os ?osVer ?format ?formatVer ?tech ?lang WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_RequirementsDevStructure ?dev . OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:DevTool_Name ?tool } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:DevTool_Version ?toolVer } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:DevOS_Name ?os } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:DevOS_Version ?osVer } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:Format_name ?format } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:Format_version ?formatVer } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:RequirementAuthoringTechnique ?tech } OPTIONAL { ?dev p510:Language ?lang } }

nl: Which documents are used in the development environment?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?doc ?desc WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_RequirementsDevStructure ?dev . ?dev p510:uses ?link . ?link a p510:Traceability_Link_Type ; p510:ContentType "Document" ; p510:Link ?doc . OPTIONAL { ?doc p510:Description ?desc } }

nl: V&V scenarios summary: scenario, credibility, and linked targets.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?scenarioId ?verLevel ?valLevel ?tipoEnlace ?targetId WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_Requirements_Verification_Validation ?vnv . ?vnv p510:Scenario ?sc . ?sc p510:Id ?scenarioId . OPTIONAL { ?sc p510:Verification_Credibility_Level ?verLevel } OPTIONAL { ?sc p510:Validation_Credibility_Level ?valLevel } OPTIONAL { { ?sc p510:Verified_by ?link . BIND("Verified_by" AS ?tipoEnlace) } UNION { ?sc p510:Validated_by ?link . BIND("Validated_by" AS ?tipoEnlace) } ?link p510:Link ?target . OPTIONAL { ?target p510:Id ?targetId } } } ORDER BY ?scenarioId

nl: Find incomplete V&V scenarios (no Verified_by and no Validated_by).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?scenarioId WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_Requirements_Verification_Validation ?vnv . ?vnv p510:Scenario ?sc . ?sc p510:Id ?scenarioId . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?sc p510:Verified_by ?_v } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?sc p510:Validated_by ?_a } } ORDER BY ?scenarioId

nl: Audit: links missing mandatory timestamps (Timestamp_Archiving or Timestamp_PLM).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?link WHERE { ?link rdf:type p510:Traceability_Link_Type . FILTER( !EXISTS { ?link p510:Timestamp_Archiving ?ta } || !EXISTS { ?link p510:Timestamp_PLM ?tp } ) }

nl: Global entity counts (requirements, models, tests, scenarios, links, documents).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?entity (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?count) WHERE { { VALUES (?entity ?type) { ("Requirement" p510:Requirement) ("DesignModel" p510:DesignModel) ("VerificationTest" p510:VerificationTest) ("VnVScenario" p510:Verification_Validation_Scenario_Type) ("TraceabilityLink" p510:Traceability_Link_Type) } ?s a ?type . } UNION { BIND("Document" AS ?entity) ?s p510:ContentType "Document" . } } GROUP BY ?entity ORDER BY ?entity

nl: Audit: physical models without a supplier (missing responsible).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?modelo ?id WHERE { ?modelo rdf:type p510:DesignModel ; p510:Id ?id ; p510:ContentType "Physical Model" . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?modelo ex:providedBy ?prov } }

nl: Audit: requirements without an approver (missing Approver).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?req ?id ?state WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id . OPTIONAL { ?req p510:Approval_State ?state } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?req p510:Approver ?a } } ORDER BY ?id

nl: Distribution of requirements by maturity state (Maturity_State).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?maturity (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?num) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req p510:Maturity_State ?maturity } } GROUP BY ?maturity ORDER BY DESC(?num)

nl: Distribution of requirements by author organization (Author_Organization).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?org (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req p510:Author_Organization ?org } } GROUP BY ?org ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: How many models are there per approval state (Approval_State)?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?approval (COUNT(DISTINCT ?modelo) AS ?numModelos) WHERE { ?modelo rdf:type p510:DesignModel ; p510:ContentType "Physical Model" . OPTIONAL { ?modelo p510:Approval_State ?approval } } GROUP BY ?approval ORDER BY DESC(?numModelos)

nl: Audit: entities marked Approved but missing Approver.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?entity ?id ?type WHERE { { ?entity rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id ; p510:Approval_State "Approved" . BIND("Requirement" AS ?type) } UNION { ?entity rdf:type p510:DesignModel ; p510:Id ?id ; p510:Approval_State "Approved" . BIND("DesignModel" AS ?type) } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?entity p510:Approver ?a } } ORDER BY ?type ?id

nl: Audit: links whose ContentType is inconsistent with the real target (p510:Link).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?link ?linkCT ?target ?targetCT WHERE { ?link rdf:type p510:Traceability_Link_Type ; p510:ContentType ?linkCT ; p510:Link ?target . OPTIONAL { ?target p510:ContentType ?targetCT } FILTER(BOUND(?targetCT) && ?linkCT != ?targetCT) } ORDER BY ?linkCT

nl: Audit: duplicate traces (same source + predicate + target repeated).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?src ?pred ?target (COUNT(DISTINCT ?link) AS ?numLinks) WHERE { VALUES ?pred { p510:Satisfied_by p510:Verified_by p510:Validated_by p510:uses } ?src ?pred ?link . ?link p510:Link ?target . } GROUP BY ?src ?pred ?target HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?link) > 1) ORDER BY DESC(?numLinks)

nl: Audit: duplicate links.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> SELECT ?src ?pred ?target (COUNT(DISTINCT ?link) AS ?numLinks) WHERE { VALUES ?pred { p510:Satisfied_by p510:Verified_by p510:Validated_by p510:uses } ?src ?pred ?link . ?link p510:Link ?target . } GROUP BY ?src ?pred ?target HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?link) > 1) ORDER BY DESC(?numLinks)

nl: Audit: links without a description.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?link ?ct WHERE { ?link rdf:type p510:Traceability_Link_Type ; p510:ContentType ?ct . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?link p510:Description ?d } } ORDER BY ?ct

nl: List the models provided by a specific supplier (e.g., Supplier 03).
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex:   <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> SELECT ?modelo ?id ?provName WHERE { ?modelo rdf:type p510:DesignModel ; p510:Id ?id ; ex:providedBy ?prov . ?prov foaf:name ?provName . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?provName)) = LCASE("Supplier 03")) } ORDER BY ?id

nl: What are the manifest project code, product, and baseline?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?projectCode ?product ?baselineName ?baselineId ?baselineCreated WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_GeneralPLMInfo ?info . OPTIONAL { ?info ex:project_code ?projectCode } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:product ?product } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:hasBaseline ?bl . OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_name ?baselineName } OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_id ?baselineId } OPTIONAL { ?bl dcterms:created ?baselineCreated } } }

nl: Distribution of requirements by subsystem.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?subsystem (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:subsystem ?subsystem } } GROUP BY ?subsystem ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: How many requirements are verified by Test/Analysis/Inspection/Demonstration?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?method (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:verification_method ?method } } GROUP BY ?method ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: List critical (High) requirements with priority and subsystem.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?id ?subsystem ?priority WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id ; ex:criticality "High" . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:subsystem ?subsystem } OPTIONAL { ?req ex:priority ?priority } } ORDER BY DESC(?priority) LIMIT 50

nl: Show the baseline and its creation date.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?projectCode ?product ?baselineName ?baselineId ?baselineCreated WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_GeneralPLMInfo ?info . OPTIONAL { ?info ex:project_code ?projectCode } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:product ?product } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:hasBaseline ?bl . OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_name ?baselineName } OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_id ?baselineId } OPTIONAL { ?bl dcterms:created ?baselineCreated } } }

nl: Which baseline version/release is loaded in the manifest?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?projectCode ?product ?baselineName ?baselineId ?baselineCreated WHERE { ?manifest rdf:type p510:P510_ManifestType ; p510:has_GeneralPLMInfo ?info . OPTIONAL { ?info ex:project_code ?projectCode } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:product ?product } OPTIONAL { ?info ex:hasBaseline ?bl . OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_name ?baselineName } OPTIONAL { ?bl ex:baseline_id ?baselineId } OPTIONAL { ?bl dcterms:created ?baselineCreated } } }

nl: Group requirements by subsystem.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?subsystem (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:subsystem ?subsystem } } GROUP BY ?subsystem ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: How many requirements are there by verification method (Test/Analysis/Inspection/Demonstration)?
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?method (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:verification_method ?method } } GROUP BY ?method ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: Show the distribution of requirements by how they are verified.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?method (COUNT(DISTINCT ?req) AS ?numRequisitos) WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:verification_method ?method } } GROUP BY ?method ORDER BY DESC(?numRequisitos)

nl: List high-criticality requirements with their priority.
sparql: PREFIX p510: <http://www.lotar.org/schemas/mbse/p510#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/tfg/mbse#> SELECT ?id ?priority WHERE { ?req rdf:type p510:Requirement ; p510:Id ?id ; ex:criticality "High" . OPTIONAL { ?req ex:priority ?priority } } ORDER BY DESC(?priority) LIMIT 50
